# Method GetVonMisesMaxAndNodePosition

#### GetVonMisesMaxAndNodePosition(DocumentId, out Point3D, out double, out string)

Gets the Von Mises maximum and node position in a result document.

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 20, 400, 100)]
void GetVonMisesMaxAndNodePosition(DocumentId inDocumentId, out Point3D outPointPosition, out double outMax, out string outTitle)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  DocumentId |  inDocumentId |  Identifier of the document to analyze.  |  
 
|  Point3D |  outPointPosition |  Maximum point.  |  
 
|  double |  outMax |  Maximum value.  |  
 
|  string |  outTitle |  Title for the point.  |
